in_marathi.name: Veeresha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Veeresha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'veera', meaning brave, heroic, and fearless. Veeresha is a powerful and strong name, suitable for a girl who is determined and protective.
